title: Tangerine Lime by Sorbet Pop 100ml
description:
Tangerine Lime by Sorbet Pop 100ml
Tangerine Lime by Sorbet Pop
is another sour candy flavored vape complimented by sweet & fruity sorbet.
Inhales with crisp citrusy lime and sweet & sour tangerine craziness with exhale.
This delicious citrusy sorbet treat is enjoyed by millions for its unique mandarin flavor and perfect texture.
Tangerine Lime by Sorbet Pop truly is a delicious blend that won’t leave you disappointed!

This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is an addictive chemical.
